title: Topological constraints on clean Lagrangian intersections via microlocal sheaf theory
summary: Fix a knot $K_0$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and consider a Lagrangian submanifold $L$ of $T^*\mathbb{R}^3$ that is isotopic to the conormal bundle of $K_0$ by a compactly supported Hamiltonian isotopy and intersects the zero section $\mathbb{R}^3$ cleanly along a knot. In this paper, using microlocal sheaf theory and some results in $3$-manifold theory, we prove that the knot type of $K_1 := L\cap \mathbb{R}^3$ in $\mathbb{R}^3$ is strictly constrained from the knot type of $K_0$.
